show.description: Once the heir to a powerful business empire, Om loses everything after a ruthless betrayal. Forced to hide his identity and live as an ordinary worker, he secretly begins a journey to uncover the truth and reclaim what was stolen from him. As enemies tighten their grip on his empire, Om must outsmart those who betrayed him. But can a fallen king reclaim his throne without revealing who he really is?
